agency.name: Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services — Division of Behavioral Health

countyDirectory.name: Nebraska Network of Care for Behavioral Health

narrNote: Nebraska does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, reviewed 2026-10-22); Nebraska has no NARR state affiliate and no mandatory state sober-home certification.
notes: The Division of Behavioral Health page self-describes as 'the designated single state mental health and substance use authority' (Nebraska's SAMHSA Single State Agency role) and states that the Division supports the Network of Care directory recorded under countyDirectory; no division phone is published on that page, so agency.phone is null. Services are administered through six regional Behavioral Health Authorities. Nebraska Family Helpline ('any question, any time,' 888-866-8660) is the statewide helpline promoted by DHHS for mental health and substance use crises; the DHHS crisis page recorded here also lists the Rural Response Hotline (800-464-0258) and 988. MHA-NE is a peer-run organization (staff and board all have lived experience) operating the Keya House and Honu Home peer respites, the peer-run REAL program, and 24/7 warmlines (Keya House 402-261-5959; Honu Home 402-975-2032). Nebraska's Section 1115 SUD demonstration (Medicaid coverage of SUD treatment, incl. IMD stays) was extended by CMS through June 30, 2030.
